name: Astral Silt Labyrinth
introDiscord: Celestial silt shifts constantly across the labyrinth, erasing paths almost as quickly as they are mapped. Shizuki tried anyway.
introTwitch: Celestial silt shifts constantly across the labyrinth, erasing paths almost as quickly as they are mapped. Shizuki tried anyway.

astral-silt-labyrinth-approach.prompt: Three passages emerge from shifting silver silt.

left.message: An Astral Silt Stalker rises from a path that looked empty approximately one second ago.

right.message:
A Berry rests beside a badly smudged map.

Shizuki wrote: "Map version 8. Current accuracy: emotionally supportive."

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary protrudes from the silt.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic sits beneath an arrow that has been crossed out seven times.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic. The arrow now points at a wall.

right.message: A Silt Stalker erupts from beneath the path.

forward.message: A cometglass seam emerges briefly from the moving silt.

astral-silt-labyrinth-threshold.prompt: Three routes converge on Buried Starlight Court.

left.message: A star-chart coffer lies half buried beneath silver sediment.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "If lost: pick direction confidently. Confidence does not help, but feels better."

forward.message:
"A Stalker rises directly from Shizuki's 'SAFE PROBABLY' marker."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire labyrinth becomes still.

Something enormous moves beneath the silt.

Use /yes to enter Buried Starlight Court or /no to leave before the floor remembers it is alive.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire labyrinth becomes still.

Something enormous moves beneath the silt.

Use !yes to enter Buried Starlight Court or !no to leave before the floor remembers it is alive.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. The labyrinth immediately rearranges behind you.

boss.revealText:
The silt erupts upward.

Siltveil Ambusher reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Court settles.

Shizuki's map remains inaccurate.

Tradition preserved."
